hero.badge: Built for teams that like getting things done
hero.title: Plan it. Assign it.
hero.description: Taskify keeps your projects, teams and tasks in one calm place. Set priorities, follow every task from to-do to done, and keep everyone in sync from your phone or the web.

features.title: Everything your team needs, nothing it doesn't
features.description: Simple enough for a personal to-do list, structured enough for a whole team.

items.title: Smart tasks
items.description: Create tasks with descriptions, due dates, priorities and a clear status so nothing slips through.

items.title: Projects
items.description: Group work into projects with deadlines, tags and members. Archive them when you're done.

items.title: Teams
items.description: Bring people together under a team leader and share projects with everyone at once.

items.title: Assign and own
items.description: Assign a task to the right person, reassign in a tap, and always know who owns what.

items.title: Comments and files
items.description: Discuss work right on the task and attach the files your team needs.

items.title: Activity and alerts
items.description: A timeline of every change plus notifications when something needs your attention.

workflow.title: Follow every task from start to finish
workflow.description: Taskify's built-in stages match how real teams work, so progress is visible at a glance.

stages.label: To do
stages.description: Captured with a clear title, owner and due date, waiting in the backlog.

stages.label: In progress
stages.description: Someone has picked it up. Teammates can see exactly who is on it.

stages.label: Review
stages.description: Work is done and ready for a second pair of eyes before it moves on.

stages.label: Testing
stages.description: Checked against the details so nothing breaks once it ships.

stages.label: Completed
stages.description: Done and logged in the activity history, and the project moves forward.

security.title: Your work stays yours
security.description: Taskify was built with privacy in mind from day one. Read the full details in our privacy policy.

items.title: Biometric app lock
items.description: Unlock with fingerprint or Face ID. Biometric data never leaves your phone.

items.title: Secure sign-in
items.description: Email verification with one-time codes and passwords stored as one-way hashes.

items.title: Light and dark mode
items.description: Easy on the eyes at any hour. Taskify follows your preference.

steps.title: Up and running in three steps

items.title: Create your account
items.description: Sign up with your email and verify it with a one-time code.

items.title: Set up a project
items.description: Add a project, invite your team and break the work into tasks.

items.title: Track and finish
items.description: Move tasks through each stage and watch the project come together.

download.title: Ready to get organised?
download.description: Taskify is available on Android and iOS. Download it and create your first project in under a minute.
